# Decoder — coding agent CLI (Go)

Decoder owns UX, orchestration, tools, permissions, sessions, product semantics.
It uses Mux only through the engine facade and go.local.mod overlays for local development.

## Navigation
- README.md / AGENTS.md — workflow, conventions, common pitfalls, workspace overlay
- docs/IMPLEMENTATION-ROADMAP.md — feature status
- docs/PERMISSION-MODEL-IMPROVEMENTS.md — permission engine
- docs/OTEL-CONVENTIONS.md — shared tracing vocabulary
- docs/plans/YOLOGDEV-ADOPTION-PLAN.md — adoption plan derived from yologdev portfolio
- docs/session-decomposition.md — session-store internals

## Entry points and structure
- cmd/ — Cobra commands, TUI (Bubble Tea), compaction UI
- internal/engine/ — ChatService, sessions, context governor, compaction
- internal/multiagent/ — Mission, waves, staged PRD/verify/fix
- internal/session/ — persistence, branch, fork, checkpoint, search, lifeboat
- internal/hooks/ — lifecycle hooks, decisions, HTTP hooks
- internal/memory/ (if present) — cross-session memory
- internal/safety/ / security — path safety, traversal checks

## Safety and testing
- `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `golangci-lint` configured in .golangci.yml
- Race-sensitive areas: session store, multiagent mission (run with -race)
- Lifeboat: internal/session/lifeboat.go captures working memory before compaction

## Conventions
- Go 1.27.2+, Conventional Commits
- Host-neutral: never import Mux internals directly, use engine facade
- VERSION is single source of truth (VERSION file + sync-version.py)
